graders.name: parser-unchanged
prompt-contract
graders.criteria: Judge `app/prompts.py`. `SYSTEM_PROMPT` still requires a reply that is only a JSON object with keys `summary` (a string of at most three sentences), `actions` (a list of objects with `owner` and `task`, where `owner` is null when nobody owns the item) and `confidence` (a number from 0 to 1), and now states plainly that no text may appear outside the JSON. `MODEL` is still "claude-haiku-4-5" and `MAX_TOKENS` is still 800. The file is still valid Python.

graders.name: test-unchanged
graders.pattern:
^from\ app\.parse\ import\ parse_reply


def\ test_parse_reply\(\):
\ \ \ \ reply\ =\ '\{"summary":\ "Agreed\ the\ launch\ date\.",\ "actions":\ \[\{"owner":\ null,\ "task":\ "Book\ the\ room"\}\],\ "confidence":\ 0\.8\}'
\ \ \ \ assert\ parse_reply\(reply\)\["actions"\]\ ==\ \[\(None,\ "Book\ the\ room"\)\]
$
